title: Constrained diffusion-enabled construction of a highly expressed and robust peptide asparaginyl ligase.
authors: Pang, Shuo; Hao, Yuxing; Mo, Jiarong; He, Yingying; Cui, Yinglu; Wu, Bian; Hemu, Xinya
one_liner_zh: 该文利用约束扩散模型生成序列并结合多模型引导突变，设计出高表达、高稳定性的肽天冬酰胺连接酶，属于蛋白质结构/序列设计计算与实验结合的核心课题。
abstract: Peptide asparaginyl ligases (PALs) hold great promise for peptide macrocyclization and protein bioconjugation, yet their broader application is limited by insufficient thermal stability and low recombinant expression. Here, we report FortiPAL-1, a diffusion-enabled PAL developed through an integrated computational-experimental strategy that couples de novo sequence generation with multi-model-guided mutagenesis and PAL-specific functional refinements. Compared with natural PALs, FortiPAL-1 exhibits markedly enhanced thermal stability (T (m) = 69  degrees C versus  approximately 50  degrees C for typical PALs) and achieves a soluble zymogen expression level of 64 mg L(-1) in E. coli, substantially exceeding reported expression levels for natural PALs, while maintaining catalytic efficiency comparable to the fastest known natural PAL, butelase-1 (k (cat)/K (m) = 1.3 x 10(6) M(-1) s(-1)). Notably, the enhanced structural stability does not translate into a corresponding shift in the optimal reaction temperature, highlighting a decoupling between global folding stability and catalytic performance. Together, these results demonstrate how a constrained, diffusion-enabled engineering workflow can transform fragile enzyme scaffolds into robust, application-ready biocatalysts and highlight the importance of integrating generative protein design with experimental optimization to translate in silico designs into high-performance dynamic enzymes.
abstract_zh: 肽天冬酰胺连接酶（PALs）在肽大环化和蛋白质生物偶联方面具有巨大潜力，但其更广泛的应用受限于热稳定性不足和重组表达水平低。在此，我们报道了FortiPAL-1，一种通过整合计算-实验策略开发的扩散增强型PAL，该策略将从头序列生成与多模型引导的诱变及PAL特异性功能优化相结合。与天然PALs相比，FortiPAL-1表现出显著增强的热稳定性（T (m) = 69 摄氏度，而典型PALs约为 50 摄氏度），并在大肠杆菌中实现可溶性酶原表达水平达64 mg L(-1)，大幅超过已报道的天然PALs表达水平，同时保持与已知最快天然PAL——butelase-1相当的催化效率（k (cat)/K (m) = 1.3 x 10(6) M(-1) s(-1)）。值得注意的是，增强的结构稳定性并未转化为最适反应温度的相应变化，凸显了整体折叠稳定性与催化性能之间的解耦。综合来看，这些结果展示了受限的、扩散增强型工程工作流如何将脆弱的酶支架转化为稳健的、可直接应用的生物催化剂，并强调了将生成式蛋白质设计与实验优化相结合以将计算机模拟设计转化为高性能动态酶的重要性。
